title: Alibaba, ByteDance Seek 10 Year Server Memory Deals From Samsung, SK Hynix

tickers.name: Alibaba Group Holding Limited American Depositary Shares, each represents eight Ordinary Shares
SK hynix Inc. American Depositary Shares

summary:
The top cloud computing firms in China have requested supply agreements for server memory from South Korean chipmakers that would last for 10 years. Alibaba, Tencent and ByteDance are seeking these contracts with Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix to secure procurement of DDR5 and LPDDR5 memory as the firms expand their artificial intelligence infrastructure.

The requests for memory supplies extending through 2035 are an outlier in the industry, where supply agreements typically span three to five years. The approach was first reported by Korean media and suggests a move by Chinese cloud providers to lock in critical hardware volumes well beyond standard cyclical planning.
